hypothesis: Eliminate demonstrably unused raw/URL-filtered index vocabulary construction while preserving every semantically required vocabulary and admission rule. No source formation or query/answer changes.
candidate_allowed_change: owning admission dictionary demand/cache only; counter evidence and independent public controls before capture
stop_rule: one complete candidate capture after independent RED/GREEN and native gates; retain every case, no successful-retry selection

acceptance.independent_opposite_controls: repeated-topic experience raw URL semantics remain correct; non-repeated/non-experience candidates do not build unused views

claims: A completed deadline or lower dictionary count is not automatically a statistically established latency or memory-answer gain.
